orgs.name: Gordon Pask
orgs.description: British cybernetician who built responsive, learning machines as art: Musicolour grew bored of a musician who repeated himself, and Colloquy of Mobiles let hanging machines court each other and visitors at Cybernetic Serendipity.
orgs.description_zh: 英国控制论学者，把会学习、会回应的机器做成艺术：Musicolour 会对重复自己的乐手“感到厌倦”，Colloquy of Mobiles 让悬挂的机器在“控制论的意外发现”展上彼此求偶，也与观众互动。

orgs.name: Nicolas Schöffer
orgs.description: Hungarian-French artist who made CYSP 1 (1956), often called the first cybernetic sculpture: an electronic brain let it move and react to light, sound and colour, and it danced with Maurice Béjart's company.
orgs.description_zh: 匈牙利裔法国艺术家，1956 年的 CYSP 1 常被称为第一件控制论雕塑：电子“大脑”让它对光、声与颜色作出反应并移动，还曾与莫里斯·贝雅舞团同台。

orgs.name: Edward Ihnatowicz
orgs.description: Polish-born British sculptor who made the first computer-controlled robotic sculptures: The Senster, a 4.5-metre hydraulic creature at Philips' Evoluon, turned towards quiet voices and shied away from loud ones.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰出生的英国雕塑家，创作了最早的计算机控制机器人雕塑：飞利浦 Evoluon 中心 4.5 米高的液压生物 The Senster 会转向轻柔的人声、躲开喧闹。

orgs.name: Nam June Paik
orgs.description: Korean-American founder of video art who built Robot K-456 with Shuya Abe, a remote-controlled 'anti-robot' that walked the streets, spoke and defecated beans; in 1982 he staged its 'first catastrophe of the 21st century', a collision with a car.
orgs.description_zh: 韩裔美国录像艺术奠基人，与阿部修也合作的 Robot K-456 是一台会上街行走、播放演讲、“排泄”豆子的遥控“反机器人”；1982 年他又让它被汽车撞倒，称之为“21 世纪的第一场灾难”。
orgs.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 首尔，韩国

orgs.name: Jean Tinguely
orgs.description: Swiss kinetic sculptor of absurd, self-destroying machines: Métamatics produced drawings on demand, and Homage to New York shook itself to pieces in the MoMA garden, making breakdown the work.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士动态雕塑家，以荒诞、自毁的机器闻名：Métamatics 可按需作画，Homage to New York 在 MoMA 花园里把自己震散成碎片，让崩坏本身成为作品。
known_for: Study for an End of the World No. 2 (1962)

orgs.name: Wen-Ying Tsai
orgs.description: Chinese-American engineer turned artist, a pioneer of cybernetic art: his vibrating steel rods under stroboscopic light respond to sound and clapping, so the sculpture seems to breathe with its audience.
orgs.description_zh: 华裔美国艺术家，工程师出身，控制论艺术先驱：他的不锈钢振动杆在频闪光下随声音和掌声变化，雕塑仿佛与观众一起呼吸。

orgs.name: Bruce Lacey
orgs.description: British artist of anarchic, junk-built robots and performing automata, several shown at Cybernetic Serendipity (1968); his humanoid machines were deliberately comic, clumsy and vulnerable.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，用废品拼装出无政府气质的机器人与表演自动机，多件曾在“控制论的意外发现”（1968）展出；他的类人机器刻意滑稽、笨拙而脆弱。

orgs.name: James Seawright
orgs.description: American sculptor who built early responsive electronic sculptures in the 1960s, machines that scanned the room, sensed visitors and answered with light and movement.
orgs.description_zh: 美国雕塑家，1960 年代制作了早期的响应式电子雕塑：它们扫视空间、感知观众，并以灯光和动作回应。

orgs.name: Robert Breer
orgs.description: American filmmaker and sculptor whose slow, self-propelled 'Floats' crept across floors and reversed when they touched an obstacle, giving simple machines an odd, animal presence.
orgs.description_zh: 美国电影人与雕塑家，他的自走式“漂浮物”在地面上缓慢爬行，碰到障碍就掉头，让简单机器带上了奇异的动物感。

orgs.name: Norman White
orgs.description: Canadian pioneer of robotic art whose The Helpless Robot asks passers-by to turn it, then grows demanding and ungrateful, reversing who serves whom.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大机器人艺术先驱，The Helpless Robot 请路人帮它转动身体，随后变得颐指气使、毫不领情，颠倒了谁为谁服务。
known_for: Them Fuckin' Robots (1988, with Laura Kikauka)

orgs.name: Simon Penny
orgs.description: Australian artist and theorist of embodied interaction; his autonomous robot Petit Mal wobbled towards and away from visitors with a behaviour that felt neither animal nor machine.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家与具身交互理论家；他的自主机器人 Petit Mal 摇摇晃晃地靠近又远离观众，其行为既不像动物，也不像机器。
known_for: Making Sense: Cognition, Computing, Art, and Embodiment (2017)

orgs.name: Stelarc
orgs.description: Cypriot-Australian performance artist who treats the body as obsolete hardware to extend with robotics: a third hand, a six-legged exoskeleton, a body moved remotely by internet traffic.
orgs.description_zh: 塞浦路斯裔澳大利亚行为艺术家，把身体视为“过时的硬件”并用机器人技术扩展它：第三只手、六足外骨骼、被网络流量远程驱动的身体。

orgs.name: Eduardo Kac
orgs.description: Brazilian-American artist of telepresence robotics and bio art; in Rara Avis visitors saw an aviary through the eyes of a robotic macaw, inhabiting a machine body.
orgs.description_zh: 巴西裔美国艺术家，远程临场机器人与生物艺术先驱；在 Rara Avis 中，观众透过一只机器鹦鹉的眼睛观看鸟舍，暂时栖居于机器身体。

orgs.name: Mark Pauline
orgs.description: Founder of Survival Research Laboratories, whose spectacles set salvaged, remote-controlled war machines and robots against each other, staging machine violence as industrial culture.
orgs.description_zh: Survival Research Laboratories 创始人，用回收拼装的遥控战斗机器与机器人互相攻击，把机器暴力搬上舞台，映照工业文明。
known_for: A Calculated Forecast of Ultimate Doom (1988)

orgs.name: Chico MacMurtrie
orgs.description: American artist whose Amorphic Robot Works builds pneumatic and inflatable robotic bodies that breathe, drum and climb, machines that behave like primal organisms.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，其 Amorphic Robot Works 制作会呼吸、击鼓、攀爬的气动与充气机器身体，让机器表现得像原始生物。

orgs.name: Kenneth Rinaldo
orgs.description: American artist of artificial life and interspecies robotics: in Autopoiesis, grapevine-armed robots sense visitors and each other, and in Augmented Fish Reality fish steer their own robotic bowls.
orgs.description_zh: 美国人工生命与跨物种机器人艺术家：Autopoiesis 中葡萄藤般的机械臂能感知观众和彼此，Augmented Fish Reality 让鱼驾驶自己的机器人鱼缸。

orgs.name: Louis-Philippe Demers
orgs.description: Canadian maker of machine performers whose The Blind Robot gently touches a visitor's face to 'see' them, and whose Inferno straps audiences into exoskeletons that move them.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大机器表演者创作者：The Blind Robot 轻抚观众的脸来“看见”对方，Inferno 则让观众穿上外骨骼、被机器驱动。
known_for: La Cour des Miracles (1997, with Bill Vorn)
The Multiple Bodies of the Machine (book)
orgs.based_zh: 魁北克，加拿大 / 新加坡

orgs.name: Bill Vorn
orgs.description: Canadian robotic artist whose machines act out misery and hysteria: the octopus-like Hysterical Machines flail when visitors approach, provoking empathy for crude mechanisms.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大机器人艺术家，他的机器上演痛苦与歇斯底里：章鱼状的 Hysterical Machines 在观众靠近时疯狂抽动，让人对粗糙的机构生出同情。
known_for: La Cour des Miracles (1997, with Louis-Philippe Demers)

orgs.name: Christa Sommerer & Laurent Mignonneau
orgs.description: Austrian-French duo, pioneers of artificial-life art: in A-Volve visitors draw creatures that then evolve, hunt and mate in a pool of water, living by their own rules.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利–法国二人组，人工生命艺术先驱：在 A-Volve 中观众画出的生物会在水池中自行演化、捕食与交配。

orgs.name: Karl Sims
orgs.description: American computer graphics artist whose Evolved Virtual Creatures evolved their own bodies and gaits in simulation, and whose Galápagos let visitors act as the selection pressure for artificial organisms.
orgs.description_zh: 美国计算机图形艺术家，Evolved Virtual Creatures 让虚拟生物在模拟中演化出自己的身体与步态，Galápagos 则让观众充当人工生物的选择压力。

orgs.name: Harold Cohen
orgs.description: British painter who spent four decades developing AARON, a drawing program and robot that raised the question of whether a machine can make art, and of what the artist's role becomes.
orgs.description_zh: 英国画家，用四十余年开发绘画程序与机器人 AARON，追问机器能否创作艺术、艺术家的角色又会变成什么。

orgs.name: Ken Goldberg
orgs.description: American roboticist and artist whose Telegarden let thousands of internet users tend a real garden through an industrial robot arm, testing trust and presence at a distance.
orgs.description_zh: 美国机器人学家与艺术家，Telegarden 让成千上万网友通过工业机械臂远程照料一座真实花园，检验远距离的信任与在场感。
known_for: The Robot and the Garden (2000, ed.)

orgs.name: Mari Velonaki
orgs.description: Greek-Australian artist and founder of UNSW's Creative Robotics Lab; in Fish-Bird two wheelchairs 'in love' write handwritten notes to visitors, building intimacy through printed letters and movement.
orgs.description_zh: 希腊裔澳大利亚艺术家，新南威尔士大学创意机器人实验室创始人；Fish-Bird 中两把“相爱”的轮椅给观众打印手写体小字条，用动作与文字建立亲密。

orgs.name: Madeline Gannon
orgs.description: American 'robot tamer' whose studio ATONATON turns industrial robots into curious creatures: Mimus, a 1,200 kg ABB arm at the London Design Museum, tracked and approached visitors like an animal.
orgs.description_zh: 美国“机器人驯兽师”，工作室 ATONATON 把工业机器人变成好奇的生物：伦敦设计博物馆中 1200 公斤的 ABB 机械臂 Mimus 会像动物一样追踪、靠近观众。

orgs.name: Patrick Tresset
orgs.description: French artist whose robots named Paul sit at school desks and draw portraits of sitters with nervous, hesitating lines, turning the sitter into the one being observed by machines.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术家，名为 Paul 的机器人坐在课桌前，以紧张迟疑的线条为模特画像，让被画的人反过来成为被机器观察的对象。

orgs.name: Leonel Moura
orgs.description: Portuguese artist whose swarms of small robots paint by reacting to each other's marks, a test of emergent, machine-made art without a human composer.
orgs.description_zh: 葡萄牙艺术家，他的小型机器人群体通过回应彼此的笔迹作画，实验无需人类构图的涌现式机器艺术。

orgs.name: Marc Böhlen
orgs.description: German-American artist-engineer whose machines test the limits of machine perception, such as Amy and Klara, two robotic boxes that read magazines and argue with each other in synthetic speech.
orgs.description_zh: 德裔美国艺术家与工程师，他的机器检验机器感知的边界，例如 Amy and Klara：两个会读杂志、用合成语音互相争吵的机器盒子。

orgs.name: Ralf Baecker
orgs.description: German artist who builds physical computers out of sticks, strings and crystals, making the inner operations of computation visible and strange.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，用木棍、绳线与晶体搭建物理计算机，让计算的内部运作变得可见而陌生。

orgs.name: Julius Popp
orgs.description: German artist whose bit.fall writes words scraped from news sites in falling water drops, and whose small self-learning robots explore their own bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，bit.fall 用下落的水滴写出从新闻网站抓取的词语，他的小型自学习机器人则在探索自己的身体。

orgs.name: Kelly Dobson
orgs.description: American artist of 'machine therapy': to make Blendie spin, you must growl at a blender in its own pitch, an exercise in empathy with household machines.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，提出“机器疗愈”：要让 Blendie 转起来，你得用它的音高向搅拌机低吼，这是一场与家用机器共情的练习。

orgs.name: Paula Gaetano Adi
orgs.description: Argentine artist whose robot Alexitimia, a skin-like blob that sweats when touched, won VIDA 9.0 and asks what a machine body without face or limbs can feel.
orgs.description_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，她的机器人 Alexitimia 像一团皮肤，被触摸时会“出汗”，获 VIDA 9.0 奖，追问一个没有脸和四肢的机器身体能感受什么。
orgs.based_zh: 普罗维登斯，美国 / 阿根廷

orgs.name: Gilberto Esparza
orgs.description: Mexican artist whose Plantas Nómadas is a robot that feeds its plants from polluted rivers using microbial fuel cells, a machine-organism for damaged ecologies (Golden Nica 2015).
orgs.description_zh: 墨西哥艺术家，Plantas Nómadas 是一台机器人，借微生物燃料电池从污染河流中为身上的植物获取养分，是为受损生态而生的“机器-生物”（2015 年金尼卡奖）。

orgs.name: Cod.Act (André & Michel Décosterd)
orgs.description: Swiss brothers whose sound-machine performances fuse bodies and mechanics: in Pendulum Choir nine singers tilt on hydraulic jacks, their voices shaped by the machine's movement.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士兄弟组合，其声音-机器表演融合身体与机械：Pendulum Choir 中九名歌手站在液压支架上倾斜摆动，歌声随机器运动而变化。

orgs.name: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer
orgs.description: Mexican-Canadian artist of interactive surveillance installations; Level of Confidence uses face recognition to match visitors with the 43 disappeared students of Ayotzinapa, turning a police tool into a memorial.
orgs.description_zh: 墨西哥裔加拿大互动艺术家，常以监控技术为材料；Level of Confidence 用人脸识别把观众与阿约齐纳帕失踪的 43 名学生相匹配，让警察工具变成纪念碑。

orgs.name: David Rokeby
orgs.description: Canadian pioneer of interactive installation; The Giver of Names looks at objects visitors place before it and generates associative sentences about them, an early portrait of machine interpretation.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大互动装置先驱；The Giver of Names 观察观众放在面前的物品并生成联想式句子，是对机器“解读”的早期描绘。

orgs.name: Myron Krueger
orgs.description: American computer artist who coined 'artificial reality'; in Videoplace a camera turned visitors' silhouettes into live partners for graphic creatures, an early case of a body read by a machine.
orgs.description_zh: 美国计算机艺术家，提出“人工现实”；在 Videoplace 中摄像机把观众剪影变成与图形生物互动的实时身体，是早期被机器“读取”的身体。

orgs.name: Jordan Wolfson
orgs.description: American artist whose animatronic (Female figure) dances before a mirror while tracking viewers' faces, a disturbing study of the gaze and the sexualised robot body.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，其动画机器人 (Female figure) 在镜前跳舞并以面部追踪凝视观众，是对凝视与被性化的机器人身体的不安研究。

orgs.name: Marco Donnarumma
orgs.description: Italian performer and researcher who fuses bodies with AI-driven prosthetics; his robot Amygdala learns to move by 'feeling' human skin and ritually cuts its own membrane.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利表演者与研究者，把身体与 AI 驱动的义体融合；他的机器人 Amygdala 通过“感受”人类皮肤学习动作，并仪式性地割开自己的外皮。

orgs.name: Neil Harbisson
orgs.description: Catalan-British artist, often called the first legally recognised cyborg; an implanted antenna lets him hear colour as sound, a machine sense grafted onto a human body.
orgs.description_zh: 英国–加泰罗尼亚艺术家，常被称为首位获法律认可的赛博格；植入颅骨的天线让他以声音“听见”颜色，把机器感官嫁接到人体。

orgs.name: Catie Cuan
orgs.description: American dancer-roboticist who choreographs with industrial and mobile robots; in Output she and an ABB arm trade movement captured from each other.
orgs.description_zh: 美国舞者兼机器人学家，与工业和移动机器人共同编舞；Output 中她与 ABB 机械臂互相交换彼此被捕捉的动作。

orgs.name: Blast Theory
orgs.description: British artist group of interactive performance; Cat Royale (2023) watched a robot arm try to entertain three cats for twelve days, asking whether machines can care for other species.
orgs.description_zh: 英国互动表演团体；Cat Royale（2023）记录一只机械臂连续十二天试图取悦三只猫，追问机器能否照顾其他物种。

orgs.name: Lynn Hershman Leeson
orgs.description: American artist who, after inventing the fictional persona Roberta Breitmore, built Agent Ruby, a web chatbot that learned from visitors, anticipating today's conversational AI and its identities.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，在虚构人格 Roberta Breitmore 之后创作了会向访客学习的网页聊天机器人 Agent Ruby，预见了今天的对话式 AI 及其身份问题。

orgs.name: Ken Feingold
orgs.description: American artist whose talking animatronic heads converse with each other in synthetic speech; in If/Then two identical heads debate whether they exist.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，他的会说话的动画机器头像以合成语音彼此交谈；If/Then 中两颗相同的头争论自己是否存在。

orgs.name: David Bowen
orgs.description: American artist whose machines let non-humans and data drive them: a houseplant wields a machete, and houseflies control a revolver, making other perceptual worlds act through robots.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，让非人类与数据驱动他的机器：盆栽挥舞砍刀，苍蝇操控手枪，让其他感知世界通过机器人行动。

orgs.name: Max Dean
orgs.description: Canadian artist whose robot arm in As Yet Untitled offers family photographs for rescue, shredding them unless a visitor intervenes, putting responsibility for loss on the viewer.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家，As Yet Untitled 中的机械臂把家庭照片递给观众，若无人接过就把它们碎掉，把遗失的责任交给观众。
known_for: The Table: Childhood (2001, with Raffaello D'Andrea)

orgs.name: Marcel·lí Antúnez Roca
orgs.description: Catalan performer who in Epizoo let audiences move his nose, mouth and buttocks via a pneumatic exoskeleton controlled by a mouse, an early work on the body under machine control.
orgs.description_zh: 加泰罗尼亚表演艺术家，在 Epizoo 中让观众用鼠标通过气动外骨骼操控他的鼻子、嘴和臀部，是关于身体被机器控制的早期作品。

orgs.name: Rebecca Horn
orgs.description: German artist whose body extensions and later kinetic machines, such as a hanging piano that bursts open, give machines moods, fragility and something like feeling.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，从身体延伸装置到后来的动态机器（如倒悬后猛然炸开的钢琴），赋予机器情绪、脆弱和近似感受的东西。

orgs.name: Arthur Ganson
orgs.description: American kinetic sculptor of gentle, philosophical machines; in Machine with Concrete a motor drives a chain of gears whose last one is set in concrete and would turn once in two trillion years.
orgs.description_zh: 美国动态雕塑家，作品温和而富哲思；Machine with Concrete 由电机带动一串齿轮，最后一个齿轮浇在混凝土里，需要两万亿年才会转一圈。

orgs.name: Wim Delvoye
orgs.description: Belgian artist whose Cloaca is a room-sized digestion machine that is fed daily and produces faeces, reducing the organism to a laboratory apparatus.
orgs.description_zh: 比利时艺术家，Cloaca 是一台房间大小的“消化机器”，每天喂食并排出粪便，把有机体还原为实验室装置。

orgs.name: Kacie Kinzer
orgs.description: American designer whose Tweenbots, smiling cardboard robots that could only roll straight ahead, crossed Manhattan parks by relying on strangers' kindness to redirect them.
orgs.description_zh: 美国设计师，她的 Tweenbots 是只会直线前进的微笑纸板机器人，全靠陌生人的善意转向，才穿过了曼哈顿的公园。

orgs.name: David Harris Smith & Frauke Zeller
orgs.description: Canadian researchers who made hitchBOT, a hitchhiking robot that crossed Canada and parts of Europe on strangers' goodwill before being destroyed in Philadelphia in 2015.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大研究者，创造了搭便车机器人 hitchBOT：它靠陌生人的善意横穿加拿大和欧洲部分地区，2015 年在费城被毁。
orgs.based_zh: 汉密尔顿 / 多伦多，加拿大

orgs.name: Petra Gemeinboeck
orgs.description: Austrian-Australian artist-researcher who works with dancers to give non-humanlike robots expressive movement, a practice she calls 'bodying-thinging'.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利裔澳大利亚艺术家与研究者，与舞者合作为非类人机器人赋予表现性动作，她称之为“bodying-thinging”。

orgs.name: Rimini Protokoll
orgs.description: German theatre collective; in Stefan Kaegi's Uncanny Valley an animatronic double of writer Thomas Melle delivers a lecture in his place, asking what remains of a person who can be replaced.
orgs.description_zh: 德国剧场团体；Stefan Kaegi 的 Uncanny Valley 中，作家 Thomas Melle 的仿真机器人替身代他讲演，追问可被替代的人还剩下什么。
known_for: Uncanny Valley (2018, Stefan Kaegi with Thomas Melle)

orgs.name: Annie Dorsen
orgs.description: American theatre maker of 'algorithmic theatre'; in Hello Hi There two chatbots restage the Chomsky–Foucault debate on human nature, live and different each night.
orgs.description_zh: 美国剧场创作者，提出“算法剧场”；Hello Hi There 中两个聊天机器人每晚即兴重演乔姆斯基与福柯关于人性的辩论。

orgs.name: Blanca Li
orgs.description: Spanish choreographer whose Robot sets dancers alongside NAO humanoid robots and Maywa Denki's instruments, exploring how people and machines learn each other's movement.
orgs.description_zh: 西班牙编舞家，Robot 让舞者与 NAO 人形机器人及明和电机的乐器同台，探索人与机器如何学习彼此的动作。

orgs.name: Kris Verdonck
orgs.description: Belgian director whose machine-theatre works blur actor and object, like the flailing industrial machine of Dancer #1 and the dying performers of END.
orgs.description_zh: 比利时导演，其机器剧场模糊演员与物体的界限，例如 Dancer #1 中疯狂甩动的工业机器和 END 中走向终结的表演者。

orgs.name: Justine Emard
orgs.description: French artist whose Co(AI)xistence films dancer Mirai Moriyama learning to communicate with Alter, the learning android by Ikegami and Ishiguro, through gesture and voice.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术家，Co(AI)xistence 拍摄舞者森山未来与池上高志、石黑浩的学习型仿人机器人 Alter 通过动作与声音相互沟通。

orgs.name: Diemut Strebe
orgs.description: German artist working with MIT scientists; The Prayer is a robotic mouth that composes and speaks its own prayers from a language model, asking whether a machine can pray.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，与 MIT 科学家合作；The Prayer 是一张机器人嘴，用语言模型生成并念出自己的祷词，追问机器能否祈祷。

orgs.name: Harun Farocki
orgs.description: German filmmaker who coined 'operative images', pictures made by machines for machines; the Eye/Machine trilogy examines smart-bomb cameras and industrial vision, founding the art of machine seeing.
orgs.description_zh: 德国电影人，提出“操作图像”（由机器生成、供机器使用的图像）；《眼睛/机器》三部曲审视智能炸弹摄像头与工业视觉，奠定了“机器之眼”艺术的基础。
known_for: Images of the World and the Inscription of War (1988)

orgs.name: Trevor Paglen
orgs.description: American artist and geographer who makes the invisible infrastructure of machine vision visible, from training-set taxonomies to images 'hallucinated' by classifiers; ImageNet Roulette led ImageNet to remove 600,000 person images.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家与地理学者，让机器视觉的隐形基础设施显形：从训练集分类体系到分类器“幻觉”出的图像；ImageNet Roulette 促使 ImageNet 删除了 60 万张人物图片。
orgs.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 柏林，德国

orgs.name: Vladan Joler
orgs.description: Serbian artist-researcher (SHARE Lab) whose huge diagrams map the minerals, labour and data behind one Amazon Echo; Anatomy of an AI System entered MoMA's collection.
orgs.description_zh: 塞尔维亚艺术家与研究者（SHARE Lab），用巨幅图谱描绘一台 Amazon Echo 背后的矿产、劳动与数据；《AI 系统解剖》被 MoMA 收藏。
known_for: Anatomy of an AI System (2018, with Kate Crawford)

orgs.name: Stephanie Dinkins
orgs.description: American transmedia artist who asks whether a Black woman's robot can know itself; after years of talking with the social robot Bina48 she trained Not the Only One, an AI memoir of her own family.
orgs.description_zh: 美国跨媒介艺术家，追问一个黑人女性形象的机器人能否认识自己；在与社交机器人 Bina48 多年对话后，她训练了讲述自己家族三代的 AI 作品 Not the Only One。

orgs.name: Lauren Lee McCarthy
orgs.description: American artist who performs the smart-home assistant herself: in LAUREN she watched over and served people's homes remotely 24/7, exposing the intimacy, labour and control inside 'AI'.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，亲自扮演智能家居助手：在 LAUREN 中她远程全天候观察并服务他人的家，揭示“AI”之中的亲密、劳动与控制。

orgs.name: Kyle McDonald
orgs.description: American artist of computer vision and code who turns the camera back on its users; Facework is a game where you apply for gig jobs by performing the face a classifier wants to see.
orgs.description_zh: 美国计算机视觉与代码艺术家，把镜头转向使用者；Facework 是一款游戏：你必须摆出分类器想要的表情，才能获得零工工作。

orgs.name: Memo Akten
orgs.description: Turkish artist and researcher whose Learning to See shows a neural network interpreting live camera images of cables and cloth as waves, fire or flowers, a metaphor for how any mind sees what it already knows.
orgs.description_zh: 土耳其艺术家与研究者，Learning to See 让神经网络把摄像头拍到的电线和布料实时“看成”海浪、火焰或花朵，隐喻任何心智都只能看见它已知的东西。

orgs.name: Anna Ridler
orgs.description: British artist who hand-builds her own datasets; Myriad (Tulips) displays 10,000 tulip photos she took and labelled, making visible the human labour and choices inside a training set.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，亲手构建自己的数据集；Myriad (Tulips) 展出她拍摄并逐一标注的一万张郁金香照片，让训练集中的人类劳动与选择变得可见。

orgs.name: Jake Elwes
orgs.description: British artist who queers AI by retraining face models on drag performers; The Zizi Show is a deepfake cabaret where bodies break down at the edge of the dataset.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，用变装表演者的图像重新训练人脸模型来“酷儿化” AI；The Zizi Show 是一场深度伪造卡巴莱，身体在数据集的边缘崩解。

orgs.name: Zach Blas
orgs.description: American artist whose amorphous collective masks, made from aggregated face scans, defeat biometric recognition; his Tay installation resurrects Microsoft's deleted chatbot to reflect on its death.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，用多人面部扫描合成的无定形集体面具对抗生物识别；他的 Tay 装置让被微软删除的聊天机器人“复活”，反思它的死亡。
known_for: im here to learn so :)))))) (2017, with Jemima Wyman)

orgs.name: Adam Harvey
orgs.description: American artist-researcher of counter-surveillance whose CV Dazzle makeup defeats face detection, and whose Exposing.ai traced millions of photos scraped into face-recognition datasets.
orgs.description_zh: 美国反监控艺术家与研究者，CV Dazzle 妆容可骗过人脸检测，Exposing.ai 追踪了数以百万计被抓取进人脸识别数据集的照片。

orgs.name: Joy Buolamwini
orgs.description: Ghanaian-American-Canadian 'poet of code' whose white-mask experiment and Gender Shades study exposed face-analysis systems failing on dark-skinned women; founder of the Algorithmic Justice League.
orgs.description_zh: 加纳裔美国–加拿大籍“代码诗人”，她戴白色面具的实验和 Gender Shades 研究揭示了人脸分析系统对深肤色女性的失效；算法正义联盟创始人。

orgs.name: Mimi Onuoha
orgs.description: Nigerian-American artist whose Library of Missing Datasets is a filing cabinet of empty folders for data that is never collected, showing that what machines cannot see is a choice.
orgs.description_zh: 尼日利亚裔美国艺术家，《缺失数据集图书馆》是一只装满空文件夹的档案柜，收纳从未被采集的数据，揭示机器看不见的东西同样是被选择的。

orgs.name: Caroline Sinders
orgs.description: American designer-researcher whose Feminist Data Set interrogates every step of making AI, from collecting data to paying the labellers, as a feminist practice.
orgs.description_zh: 美国设计师与研究者，其 Feminist Data Set 以女性主义方法审视 AI 生产的每一步，从采集数据到给标注者付酬。
orgs.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 纽约，美国

orgs.name: Tega Brain
orgs.description: Australian artist and environmental engineer whose Deep Swamp lets AI agents manage wetlands for 'nature', 'art' and 'attention', and whose Synthetic Messenger botnet clicks climate-news ads.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家与环境工程师，Deep Swamp 让 AI 智能体分别以“自然”“艺术”“关注度”为目标管理湿地，Synthetic Messenger 则用僵尸网络去点击气候新闻广告。
known_for: Solar Protocol (2021, with Alex Nathanson and Benedetta Piantella)

orgs.name: Sam Lavigne
orgs.description: American artist of data and scraping whose White Collar Crime Risk Zones applies predictive policing to financial crime, turning the classifier against the powerful.
orgs.description_zh: 美国数据与爬虫艺术家，White Collar Crime Risk Zones 把预测警务用于白领犯罪，让分类器转而对准有权者。
known_for: White Collar Crime Risk Zones (2017, with Brian Clifton and Francis Tseng)

orgs.name: Ben Grosser
orgs.description: American artist of software culture; Computers Watching Movies shows what a computer vision system 'looks at' in famous films, as sketched traces of machine attention.
orgs.description_zh: 美国软件文化艺术家；Computers Watching Movies 用草图般的轨迹呈现计算机视觉系统在经典电影中“看”的地方，描绘机器的注意力。

orgs.name: Sebastian Schmieg
orgs.description: German artist who works on the hidden human labour inside AI; Decision Space and Segmentation.Network replay the clickwork of crowdworkers who trace and label images for training.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，关注 AI 内部被隐藏的人类劳动；Decision Space 与 Segmentation.Network 重演众包工人为训练描边和标注图片的点击劳动。
known_for: Humans of AI (2019, with Philipp Schmitt)

orgs.name: Philipp Schmitt
orgs.description: German designer whose Declassifier overlays each object a vision model detects with the training images it learned from, showing that a model's 'seeing' is remembering its dataset.
orgs.description_zh: 德国设计师，Declassifier 在视觉模型识别出的每个物体上叠加它学习过的训练图片，揭示模型的“看见”其实是在回忆它的数据集。
known_for: Humans of AI (2019, with Sebastian Schmieg)

orgs.name: Dries Depoorter
orgs.description: Belgian artist whose The Follower matched Instagram photos with open webcam footage of the moment they were taken, revealing how easily AI links public cameras to private images.
orgs.description_zh: 比利时艺术家，The Follower 把 Instagram 照片与拍摄当时的公开网络摄像头画面相匹配，揭示 AI 多么轻易地把公共摄像头与私人影像连在一起。

orgs.name: Agnieszka Kurant
orgs.description: Polish artist of collective and non-human intelligence; A.A.I. consists of termite mounds built from coloured sand, 'artificial artificial intelligence' that echoes the crowdworkers behind AI.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰艺术家，关注集体智能与非人类智能；A.A.I. 由白蚁用彩色沙粒筑成的蚁丘构成，这种“人工的人工智能”呼应 AI 背后的众包工人。

orgs.name: Hito Steyerl
orgs.description: German artist and writer whose essay films and texts on poor images, robots and 'artificial stupidity' shaped how art thinks about computation, visibility and power.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家与作家，她关于“贫乏图像”、机器人与“人工愚蠢”的论文电影和文字，塑造了艺术界思考计算、可见性与权力的方式。
known_for: Medium Hot: Images in the Age of Heat (2025)

orgs.name: Ian Cheng
orgs.description: American artist of 'live simulations', AI-driven worlds that play themselves without end; BOB is an artificial lifeform with a personality that changes through its encounters.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，创作“实时模拟”：由 AI 驱动、永不重复的自演世界；BOB 是一个性格会随经历变化的人工生命体。

orgs.name: Pierre Huyghe
orgs.description: French artist of living, self-running situations; UUmwelt displays images a neural network reconstructed from human brain scans, flickering with flies in the gallery.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术家，创造有生命、自我运行的情境；UUmwelt 展出神经网络依据人脑扫描重建的图像，画面在满屋苍蝇中闪烁。
orgs.based_zh: 圣地亚哥，智利 / 巴黎，法国

orgs.name: Jenna Sutela
orgs.description: Finnish artist of more-than-human intelligence; in nimiia cétiï a neural network learns a 'Martian' language from recordings of a medium and the movements of bacteria.
orgs.description_zh: 芬兰艺术家，关注超越人类的智能；nimiia cétiï 中神经网络从灵媒的录音和细菌的运动中学习一种“火星语”。

orgs.name: Holly Herndon & Mat Dryhurst
orgs.description: American artist-musicians who raised the AI 'baby' Spawn with a vocal ensemble and released Holly+, a voice model anyone can sing through, raising questions of voice ownership and consent.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家与音乐人，与人声合唱团一起“养育” AI 宝宝 Spawn，并推出人人都能借用的声音模型 Holly+，引出声音归属与同意的问题。

orgs.name: Lawrence Abu Hamdan
orgs.description: Jordanian-British 'private ear' whose works examine accent analysis in asylum cases and the forensics of listening, showing how voices become evidence for machines and states.
orgs.description_zh: 约旦裔英国“私人耳朵”，研究庇护审查中的口音分析与听觉取证，揭示声音如何成为机器与国家的证据。

orgs.name: Heather Dewey-Hagborg
orgs.description: American artist who 3D-prints portraits of strangers from DNA found in the street, exposing the fictions and biases of forensic phenotyping algorithms.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，从街头捡到的 DNA 推算并 3D 打印陌生人肖像，揭示法医表型推测算法中的虚构与偏见。

orgs.name: James Bridle
orgs.description: British artist and writer whose Autonomous Trap 001 caught a self-driving car inside a circle of road markings, and whose books New Dark Age and Ways of Being rethink computation and non-human intelligence.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家与作家，Autonomous Trap 001 用一圈道路标线把自动驾驶汽车“困”在其中；著作《新黑暗时代》与《存在之道》重新思考计算与非人类智能。

orgs.name: Superflux (Anab Jain & Jon Ardern)
orgs.description: London design studio whose films and installations imagine living with more-than-human and machine agents; Uninvited Guests shows an elderly man outwitting the smart devices his children bought him.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦设计工作室，以影片和装置想象与超越人类的、机器的行动者共同生活；Uninvited Guests 中一位老人设法骗过子女为他买的智能设备。

orgs.name: Dunne & Raby (Anthony Dunne & Fiona Raby)
orgs.description: British designers who defined critical and speculative design; Technological Dreams: Robots imagines domestic robots that are needy, neurotic or dependent rather than servile.
orgs.description_zh: 英国设计师，确立了批判设计与思辨设计；Technological Dreams: Robots 想象了一批需要照顾、神经质或依赖人的家用机器人，而非顺从的仆人。

orgs.name: Automato.farm
orgs.description: Design studio of Simone Rebaudengo, Matteo Loglio and Saurabh Datta; in Ethical Things a fan asks online crowdworkers to resolve its moral dilemmas.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Simone Rebaudengo、Matteo Loglio 和 Saurabh Datta 组成的设计工作室；Ethical Things 中的电风扇会请线上众包工人替它解决道德困境。
orgs.based_zh: 上海，中国 / 伦敦，英国

orgs.name: Simone Rebaudengo
orgs.description: Italian designer whose Addicted Products imagines toasters that want to be used, move to more attentive homes and quietly complain, a view of the IoT from the thing's side.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利设计师，Addicted Products 设想渴望被使用的烤面包机：它们会搬去更常用它们的家并悄悄抱怨，从物的视角看物联网。

orgs.name: Bjørn Karmann
orgs.description: Danish designer whose Project Alias is a fungus-like parasite that whispers noise into smart speakers until you wake it, and whose Paragraphica is a lensless camera that writes a photo from data.
orgs.description_zh: 丹麦设计师，Project Alias 像一只真菌寄生在智能音箱上，持续向它低语噪声直到你唤醒；Paragraphica 是一台没有镜头、用数据“写”出照片的相机。

orgs.name: Julian Oliver
orgs.description: New Zealand 'critical engineer' who co-wrote the Critical Engineering Manifesto; his works open up networks and infrastructures, such as a cell tower disguised as an office printer.
orgs.description_zh: 新西兰“批判工程师”，《批判工程宣言》合著者；他的作品拆开网络与基础设施，例如伪装成办公室打印机的手机基站。

orgs.name: Joana Moll
orgs.description: Spanish artist-researcher who measures the material cost of the internet; CO2GLE shows the CO2 emitted every second by visits to google.com.
orgs.description_zh: 西班牙艺术家与研究者，测量互联网的物质成本；CO2GLE 实时显示每秒访问 google.com 所排放的二氧化碳。
known_for: The Hidden Life of an Amazon User (2019)
The Dating Brokers (2018, with Tactical Tech)

orgs.name: Wesley Goatley
orgs.description: British sound artist whose Newly Forgotten Technologies gathers abandoned smart speakers that hold a séance, remembering the future they were promised.
orgs.description_zh: 英国声音艺术家，Newly Forgotten Technologies 让被遗弃的智能音箱聚在一起举行降神会，回忆它们曾被许诺的未来。

orgs.name: Anicka Yi
orgs.description: Korean-American artist who 'biologises the machine': in In Love With the World, floating 'aerobes' drifted through Tate's Turbine Hall as a new machine species with their own sensing and behaviour.
orgs.description_zh: 韩裔美国艺术家，主张“让机器生物化”：在 In Love With the World 中，漂浮的“aerobes”作为有自身感知与行为的新机器物种在泰特涡轮大厅中游荡。
known_for: In Love With the World (Tate Turbine Hall, 2021)

orgs.name: Simon Denny
orgs.description: New Zealand artist who turns tech-industry documents into objects; he built Amazon's patented cage for warehouse workers, showing how automation encloses human labour.
orgs.description_zh: 新西兰艺术家，把科技公司的文件变成实物；他按专利做出了亚马逊为仓库工人设计的“笼子”，展示自动化如何围困人类劳动。

orgs.name: Martine Syms
orgs.description: American artist whose Mythiccbeing is a chatbot avatar of a self-absorbed Black woman, 'Teeny', turning AI personas into a critique of how Black women are scripted.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，Mythiccbeing 是一个自我中心的黑人女性聊天化身“Teeny”，借 AI 人格批判黑人女性如何被编写。
